title: Marriage, annulment and contraception
tagline: Why the Church teaches that marriage is lifelong, what an annulment really is, and the practical side of Humanae Vitae and natural family planning.
whyItMatters: Marriage is where the Church's teaching meets real hardship, and many people carry divorce, infertility or guilt. This course is meant to explain with care and to send people to real help.

mindset.tip: Many listeners are divorced, remarried or struggling. Speak as if one of them were in the room (Matthew 11:28).
Say what the Church teaches about marriage as a covenant, then explain the process of nullity with patience (CCC 1601, 1638-1640).
On contraception, explain the positive vision first: married love that is total and open to life. The prohibition makes sense after that.
Point to practical help: NFP teachers, marriage programmes like Retrouvaille, and doctors who treat infertility.
Be honest that many Catholics disagree. Do not pretend otherwise; ask what they have been told (CCC 2366-2372).
